sections.section_title: DUAL DAC 8-bit right aligned data holding register (DAC_DHR8RD)
sections.text_helper: Section 12.5.11 "DUAL DAC 8-bit right aligned data holding register (DAC_DHR8RD)" in chapter 12 (Digital-to-analog converter (DAC)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 272.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x28
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reserved
Bits 31:16 Reserved.
Bits 15:8 DACC2DHR[7:0]: DAC channel2 8-bit right-aligned data
These bits are written by software which specify 8-bit data for DAC channel2.
Bits 7:0 DACC1DHR[7:0]: DAC channel1 8-bit right-aligned data
These bits are written by software which specify 8-bit data for DAC channel1.
